title: The Lightest Aero Bike In the Peloton?! Giant Propel 2026 First Look

takeaways.text: A one-piece cockpit replaces the two-piece bar and stem, claimed 13% more compliant and 80 g lighter, with flared drops and a narrower hood position.

Seatstays drop about 3 cm (claimed 25% more compliance on the integrated-seatpost Advanced SL frame), a UDH hanger is added and clearance rises from 30 to 32 mm; the frameset is only about 40 g lighter.
The SRAM Red Advanced SL 0 is quoted at 6.56 kg; most of the saving comes from the cockpit and hookless Cadex Max 50 wheels (claimed 1,290 g).
The Ultegra Di2 Advanced Pro weighed 7.19 kg on BikeRadar's scales with an uncut steerer; it uses a telescoping seatpost rather than a cut-to-length seat mast.

disclosure: Publication first look at Giant's launch bikes; the flagship shown is the Advanced SL 0, which shares the Advanced SL frame grade with the candidate's SL 1.
summary: BikeRadar's launch overview of the fourth-generation (2026) Giant Propel, covering the Advanced SL 0, Advanced Pro and Advanced 2 builds.
